outcome.implementation_scope: Expose bounded session diagnostic history summaries and exact validated same-session evidence references through ECI session activity.
outcome.relation_recording_change: Record the verified implementation, verification, and subsequent live readback relationship at the top-level improvement_relation field consumed by the existing ECI schema. The earlier immutable record and correction attempt are preserved.
outcome.prior_correction_result: The correction contract did not apply because the original record had no top-level improvement relation to repair. ECI reported replacement-values-unverified-or-unchanged; this was not interpreted as implementation or verification failure.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This record establishes a schema-valid evidence relationship candidate. Its acceptance and content integrity remain subject to the subsequent ECI projection readback.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

improvement_relation.basis: The baseline implementation source lacked a session diagnostic projection path. The implementation and response bounds passed focused verification and the Environment vertical proof. A post-commit ECI query retained the authentic diagnostic summary and exact evidence reference alongside a separately correlated resource sample under a partial, response-truncated response.
not_measured: agent discovery, receipt, or usability across different runtimes and models
whether an agent would otherwise have performed a separate diagnostic query
intervention time, token use, or resource cost saved
cross-session recurrence and generality of diagnostic-history shapes
future evidence that the projection changes diagnostic service quality

measurement_limits: The new relation is not accepted or integrity-verified until the next ECI readback.
The earlier nested relation and rejected correction attempt remain immutable campaign evidence and are not rewritten.
The same-session live readback does not establish independent agent discovery, intervention reduction, long-term recurrence, or effectiveness.
